copy.heroEyebrow: Made by hand, made to order
copy.heroHeadline: Little things, sewn one at a time
copy.heroSub: Kids clothes, quilted bags, and Bible bags cut, sewn, and finished by hand in Ottumwa, Iowa. You pick the size and the fabric. We make it for you.

valueProps.title: Made to order
valueProps.body: Nothing sits on a shelf. Your piece is cut and sewn after you order, so you get the size and the fabric you actually want.

valueProps.title: Two fabrics, your pairing
valueProps.body: Every piece uses a primary fabric and a secondary fabric. Pick both and we will build the piece around your combination.

valueProps.title: Small batch, local
valueProps.body: One maker, one sewing machine, one small town in Southeast Iowa. Questions go straight to a person.

howItWorks.body: Pick a style, then set the size. Sizes run from 0 to 3 months up to 7 to 8 years on the kids pieces.
Choose a primary fabric for the main body and a secondary fabric for the trim, lining, or contrast.

howItWorks.step: We sew it and ship it
howItWorks.body: Your piece is cut and sewn by hand, then shipped from Ottumwa. Expect about 2 to 3 weeks.

copy.fabricSectionBody: Every piece is built from a primary fabric and a secondary fabric. Pick a combination on any product page. If you want something you do not see here, ask.
aboutBody: LivLocal is a small, family-run shop. Every piece is cut, sewn, pressed, and finished by hand, in small batches, in Southeast Iowa.
The work started with kids clothes and grew into quilted bags and Bible bags. More is coming as new patterns are finished.
Because everything is made to order, you are never choosing from whatever happened to be left in a warehouse. You are choosing the size, the fabric, and the pairing.
copy.ctaBandBody: Custom sizes, custom fabric pairings, and small runs are all possible. Tell us what you are picturing.

tax.label: Sales tax (Iowa 7%)
tax.note: Ottumwa is 6% Iowa state tax plus a 1% local option tax, so 7.0% combined. Left OFF by default because LivLocal must hold an Iowa sales tax permit before collecting tax. Confirm with the Iowa Department of Revenue, then set enabled to true.

faq.q: How long until my order ships?
faq.a: Everything is made to order. Expect about 2 to 3 weeks for your piece to be cut, sewn, and finished, then 3 to 5 business days in transit.

faq.q: How do sizes work on the kids pieces?
faq.a: Sizes run from 0 to 3 months up to 7 to 8 years. The price steps up as the piece gets larger, because the fabric and sewing time grow with it.
Every piece is built from a primary fabric and a secondary fabric. The primary fabric is the main body. The secondary fabric is the trim, lining, ties, or contrast detail.

faq.q: Can I pick a fabric that is not listed?
faq.a: Yes. Send us a message with what you have in mind and we will tell you whether it is available and how it changes the price.
Made-to-order pieces are cut specifically for you, so they are not returnable. If something arrives damaged or does not match what you ordered, contact us and we will fix it.

faq.q: Do you ship outside the United States?
faq.a: Not yet. Shipping is currently within the United States. Ask if you need something sent elsewhere and we will look into it.
Yes. Choose local pickup at checkout if you are in or near Ottumwa, Iowa.

faq.q: Can I order a custom size or a custom piece?
faq.a: Yes. Custom sizes, custom fabric pairings, and small runs are all possible. Start with the contact page.
